# LZMA SDK (7z decoder)

The 7z reading part of the LZMA SDK by Igor Pavlov (public domain), from 7-Zip 26.06
(https://github.com/ip7z/7zip, `C/`): the files the SDK's own `C/Util/7z` extractor builds with, unchanged.
The launcher uses it to install mods packed as `.7z` (tools/launcher/sevenzip.cpp).
